blind.description: A gothic-style decorative architectural corbel or shelf bracket. It features a flat rectangular top shelf resting on a carved support structure. The front carving depicts a detailed black raven or crow perched on top of a classic hourglass, flanked by gothic tracery side panels. The back is flat for wall mounting. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and cleanly sculpted in tan stone/wood textures with a dark raven and detailed hourglass elements.
blind.from_above: A flat tan rectangular surface with softly rounded corners, showing the tiny black tip of the raven's beak protruding slightly past the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and about 1.2 feet wide.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
